notes: 02: only the <title> is auto-collected (lookupTitle); no description, favicon, or preview image. 03: title editable before/after save, but no description field exists to edit. 04: edit form covers url/title/tags/note but there is no description field. 07: item view shows title, tags, host text and note, but no favicon image and no description. 10: tag input adds on Enter/comma with no autocomplete/suggestions of existing tags. 14: search has no '#tag' syntax; tags stored without '#' so '#x' never matches. 15: matchesSearch is implicit-AND over whitespace terms; no OR/NOT/parentheses/quoting rule. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. 20: no multi-select or bulk actions in UI or API. 21: no bulk-action-on-filtered-collection feature. 22: list() is fixed newest-first (date added); no sort-key selection or alternate keys. 23: note is stored/displayed as plain text (el text:), not rendered as markdown. 24: capturePage stores extracted readable text as JSON, not a single-file HTML snapshot, and has no PDF-download rule. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 26: no archive flag/concept. 27: only delete exists; no reversible archive to distinguish. 28: no archived-only list. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no export. 32: no user/display settings (sort, items-per-page, font size).
